_readme: Reviewed exceptions to the dependency-advisory gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs). Each entry needs an advisory id (GHSA-…), the reason it is acceptable, and a date by which it must be judged again. Delete an entry when the dependency is updated past the fix.

entries.reason: Reached only through PostCSS inside Next.js's compiler at build time. nanoid is never called with a caller-supplied size at run time or from visitor input. Goes away with the next Next.js/PostCSS update.

Reached only through styled-jsx → Babel inside Next.js at build time. The advisory needs untrusted browserslist queries; the project's are fixed in the repository. Goes away with the next Next.js update.
Same path and same reasoning as GHSA-c83g-rgw3-j3cx: build-time only, queries come from the repository, not from a visitor.
